content.title: Tickets and Hospitality
content.text: HOW TO ATTEND LA28 YOUR GAMES, YOUR WAY ACCESS THE GAMES THROUGH TICKETS & HOSPITALITY Whether you’re looking to cheer from the stands with thousands of fans or experience the Games with a suite view, LA28 has an option for you. The 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games will be the biggest sporting celebration ever to come to Los Angeles. We’ve got multiple ways to attend to ensure no one misses a moment of the magic: GENERAL TICKETS let fans join the action in the stands, with flexible pricing for every budget. HOSPITALITY PACKAGES take it to the next level, combining guaranteed tickets with premium hospitality experiences, travel and unforgettable extras. GENERAL TICKETS CHEER YOUR TEAM ON From Swimming finals to Track and Field heats, choose the moments you don’t want to miss. Registration for the first draw is closed, but we’re just getting started. Sign up for the LA28 newsletter to be notified about registration for future ticket draws. Additionally, group tickets of 50+ and 20+ for the Olympics and Paralympics, respectively, will be available through LA28. OLYMPIC HOSPITALITY GO BEYOND THE STANDS LA28 Olympic Hospitality packages are now available, offering official tickets with elevated hospitality experiences including top-tier seating, private lounges, dining, travel and dedicated service. Olympic Hospitality packages are open to the public and delivered by On Location, the Official Hospitality Provider of the LA28 Olympic and Paralympic Games. Disclaimer *NO PURCHASE OR PAYMENT REQUIRED TO REGISTER, ENTER OR WIN. RESTRICTIONS APPLY. ELIGIBILITY SUBJECT TO VERIFICATION. MUST BE AT LEAST 18 YEARS OF AGE AT TIME OF REGISTRATION.
